_note: Form Coach movement definitions. PURE DATA - adding a third movement means adding an entry here, not writing code. Each check names a measurement the engine already knows how to compute, a taught-fundamental target range, the cue spoken when it's out of range, and a priority (1 = fix first). Target ranges are widely-taught fundamentals, not personalised coaching; good form varies by body, sport and coach. IMPORTANT: every measurement here is chosen to be visible from a SIDE view with one camera. Lateral faults (true elbow flare out to the side, knees caving inward) are simply not observable side-on, so they are NOT measured here rather than being guessed at - they would need a front view.

_measurements.elbowAngleAtSet: shoulder-elbow-wrist angle at the lowest wrist point before release
_measurements.releaseElbowAngle: shoulder-elbow-wrist angle at the frame of peak wrist height
_measurements.followThroughHold: seconds the wrist stays above the shoulder after release
_measurements.kneeAngleAtDepth: hip-knee-ankle angle at the lowest hip point (smaller = deeper)
_measurements.hipAngleAtDepth: shoulder-hip-knee angle at the lowest hip point (smaller = more hinge)
_measurements.torsoLeanAtDepth: angle of the shoulder-hip line from vertical at the lowest hip point
_measurements.kneeTravelAtDepth: how far the knee sits forward of the ankle at depth, as a fraction of shin length; side-on this is forward travel, NOT lateral knee cave
_measurements.releaseHeight: wrist height above the shoulder at release, as a multiple of the shoulder-to-ear distance; side-on proxy for releasing high rather than pushing the ball from the chest

movements.title: Basketball shot
movements.setup: Stand side-on to the phone, shooting arm nearest the camera, whole body in frame.

checks.cueLow: You're collapsing the elbow too far - set the ball with about a right angle at the elbow.
checks.cueHigh: Your set point's too open - bend the elbow closer to a right angle before you go up.
checks.good: Good set point on the elbow.

checks.cue: Finish the arm - extend all the way up through the release.
checks.good: You're extending fully through the release.

checks.cue: You're releasing from too low - get the ball up above your head before it leaves your hand.
checks.good: Release point is nice and high.

checks.cue: Hold the follow-through - keep the hand up until the ball lands.

movements.title: Bodyweight squat
movements.setup: Stand side-on to the phone, whole body from head to feet in frame.

checks.cue: You're folding forward - lift your chest and sit back instead.
Go a little deeper - aim for thighs about parallel to the floor.
Push your hips back as you go down rather than dropping straight through the knees.
checks.good: Nice hip hinge on the way down.

checks.cue: Your knees are running a long way past your toes - sit back into your hips more.
